title: Teresita Fernández Installation Will Grace The Reopening Of The Menil’s Fresco Building In Houston
summary: New York–based artist Teresita Fernández has been revealed as the first artist in a new commissions program for the reopening of the Menil Collection’s Fresco Building in late 2027. The historic structure, which has been closed since 2018, will be repurposed for semi-permanent, site-specific commissions. title: David Nahmad Given 30 Days to Return Nazi-Looted Modigliani
summary: A New York Supreme Court judge on June 16 gave billionaire dealer David Nahmad thirty days to return Amedeo Modigliani’s 1918 painting Seated Man with a Cane to the family of Jewish antiques dealer Oscar Stettiner, who left it in his Paris shop as he fled the Nazis during World War II. title: Barack and Michelle Obama Unveil First Dual Portrait Painted By Artist Njideka Akunyili Crosby
summary: In the lead up to the formal opening of the Obama Presidential Center in Chicago, former US president Barack Obama and former first lady Michelle Obama revealed their first dual portrait on June 15. title: Baloise Art Prize for Emerging Artists at Art Basel Canceled
summary: The Baloise Art Prize at Art Basel will not be awarded in 2026, the Art Newspaper reports. Established in 1999, the SFr30,000 (roughly $37,000) honor had been presented annually to two artists whose work appeared in the fair’s Statements section, devoted to emerging artists. title: Trellis Art Fund Announces 2026 Recipients of $100,000 Milestone Grant
summary: The Trellis Art Fund has named the dozen artists making up its 2026 Milestone Grant cohort. Each will receive an unrestricted grant of $100,000, disbursed in two installments over a two-year period. title: Russian Artist And Political Dissident Robert ⁠Kuzovkov Shot Dead In Poland
summary: On June 16, Robert Kuzovkov, a Russian artist and political dissident, was killed outside his home in Biała Podlaska, a city in eastern Poland. Kuzovkov, 44, who often used the artistic name Semyon Skrepetsky, was a fierce critic of Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chechen leader Ramzan Kadyrov, and other world leaders. summary: The Houston Museum of African American Culture (HMAAC) revealed last week that a painting depicting a Black man draped in an American flag had been intentionally damaged last month. title: José Roca Named Curator of 37th Ljubljana Biennale of Graphic Arts
summary: MGLC, the International Centre of Graphic Arts in Slovenia, has appointed Colombian curator José Roca curator of the 37th Ljubljana Biennale of Graphic Arts, to take place in 2027. title: 2026 Frieze Seoul Artist Award Goes to Yagwang
summary: Frieze has named Seoul-based collective Yagwang as the recipient of this year’s Frieze Seoul Artist Award. Now in its fourth year, like Frieze Seoul, the honor is presented annually to an emerging or midcareer Korean artist in support of new work. summary: The Whitney Museum of American Art, New York, has announced Soyoung Yoon as the new director of its prestigious Independent Study Program, effective immediately. summary: “The Widad Kawar Collection of Arab Dress and Heritage Arts”—comprising nearly 600 textiles, accessories, garments and other objects that attest to daily life across the Levant region and West Asia—has now found a home at the Royal Ontario Museum (ROM) in Toronto, Canada.
